title: 1Password for Agents - AI login karega, password dekhe bina
content:
Aapka AI agent aapke account mein login karega.
But it will never see your password.
1Password ne launch kiya hai 1Password for Agents.
Problem simple hai. AI agents ab hamare liye websites pe kaam karte hain. Booking, shopping, forms.
Lekin login ke liye unhe password chahiye. Aur apna password kisi AI ko de dena, ye risky lagta hai na?
Toh ye kaam kaise karta hai?
Step one. Agent login ki request bhejta hai.
Step two. Aap 1Password mein us request ko approve karte ho.
Step three. 1Password khud password ya one-time code seedha sign-in page mein bhar deta hai.
The agent never receives the credential. It only gets a logged-in page.
Aur yahan ek important detail hai.
1Password ke hisaab se access sirf usi item ke liye hota hai jo aapne approve kiya.
Baaki vault agent ke liye band rehta hai.
Ye itna important kyun hai?
Kyunki agents ka sabse bada blocker intelligence nahi, trust hai.
Log AI ko kaam dena chahte hain, lekin apni keys dena nahi chahte.
This is a pattern you will see everywhere. Give the agent the result of a permission, not the secret itself.
Aap ise kaise use kar sakte ho?
Agar aap agents use karte ho, toh kabhi bhi apna password chat mein paste mat karo.
Aur agar aap agents bana rahe ho, toh same idea apne product mein lao.
Maan lo aapka agent kisi client ke CRM mein data update karta hai.
Agent ko permanent password mat do. Har sensitive action pe human approval lo, aur access ko ek kaam tak limited rakho.
Mera take simple hai.
Jo agent safe nahi hai, wo kitna bhi smart ho, koi company use nahi karegi.
Security seekh lo. AI jobs mein ye sabse underrated skill hai.
